computed_on.note: values identical to R3 audit — corpus/gold-level facts, not pipeline-dependent

A1.question: share of slice queries with >=1 useful session strictly earlier (oracle ceiling B3)
A1.gate: >= 0.30 for hit to be about the ranker

A2.question: share of gold pairs splitting < TAG_FIELDS_MIN under gold tags

A3.question: unique tag_key count + median bucket size on gold_tags

A4.question: share of slice queries with > MAX_PACKET candidates (gold tags)
A4.value: N/A (gold_tags not authorized); proxy below on the unlock-universe
A4.note: tag-based candidate counts land in metrics.json.retrieve from the run; explore_fill gate is about tag candidates

A6.question: median transcript tokens x MAX_PACKET (honest packet_tokens_p50 ceiling)
A6.method: len(text)//4 on pool-union transcripts (fallback per EVAL-PLAN §4.6)

ROTATION_BURN_IN.question: first query index after which share of queries with >= MAX_PACKET candidates is stably > 0
ROTATION_BURN_IN.basis: unlock-universe candidate scope (no tag model needed)
